newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX DENIED CHANCE OF CLOSING GAP ON LEADERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX DENIED CHANCE OF CLOSING GAP ON LEADERS.

text.p: Champions Ajax Amsterdam missed a chance to close the gap on league leaders Feyenoord Rotterdam and main rivals PSV Eindhoven when they were held to a 1-1 draw at Utrecht on Sunday.
The two top clubs had both been held to draws earlier in the weekend and Ajax, who have made an uninspired start to the season, must have fancied their chances against lowly Utrecht.
But Ajax suffered an early setback when Hans Visser fired home a free kick in the 11th minute to put Utrecht ahead.
Nordin Wooter levelled the scores two minutes before the interval when he scored from a rebound after goalkeeper Rene Ponk had failed to hold a shot by Martijn Reuser.
Both sides played aggressively in the second half but neither could find the net. It left Ajax in sixth place on 16 points after 10 matches.

Several arrests were made before the match when riot police were called in to separate rival supporters in Utrecht's city centre. A policewoman was reported by officials to have been hurt in the incident.

Feyenoord head the table with 23 points after being held to a 1-1 draw by third from the bottom RKC Waalwijk while PSV managed only the same scoreline away to Fortuna Sittard on Friday to be two points adrift in second place.
